items.definition:
relating to the autonomic nervous system; involuntary
Breathing is an autonomic function of the body.

abstaining from marriage and sexual relations
Some religious orders require their members to be celibate.

relating to the art of writing or solving codes
The system uses strong cryptographic algorithms to protect sensitive data.

lacking a body or physical form
We heard a disembodied voice coming from the empty room, which was quite eerie.

abnormally thin or weak, especially because of illness or lack of food
The stray dog was emaciated and weak from hunger and neglect.

special; particular
He took especial care to ensure everything was perfect for the presentation.

relating to or affecting a gland or glands
The doctor suspected a glandular problem.

capable of or tending to commit homicide
The patient was deemed a homicidal risk.

relating to or affecting several generations
The program aims to foster intergenerational understanding.

without love or affection
He described his childhood as a loveless existence.

very vivid in color, especially so as to create an unpleasantly harsh or unnatural effect; presenting in vividly shocking or sensational terms
The newspaper published a lurid account of the crime.

relating to the gums and tissues around teeth
She needed treatment for periodontal disease.

relating to or along a tangent; only slightly connected
His comments were tangential to the main topic of discussion.

having or showing a dislike of or prejudice against transgender people
The organization aims to combat transphobic attitudes in society.

(of a woman) curvaceous and sensuously attractive
The artist painted a voluptuous figure.

relating to the carpus (wrist bones)
Carpal tunnel syndrome affects the median nerve in the wrist.

harmful or damaging
The chemical had a deleterious effect on the environment.

having characteristics regarded as typical of a woman; unmanly
His effeminate gestures were sometimes misunderstood.

involving sexual relations between people too closely related to marry
The novel explored the theme of an incestuous relationship.

impossible to contradict or evade; covered with iron plates
They had an ironclad agreement that could not be broken.

relating to the system of sounds in a language
Children often struggle with phonological awareness before learning to read.

relating to the period following a surgical operation
The patient required close monitoring during the postoperative recovery period.

relating to the phase of the heartbeat when the heart muscle contracts and pumps blood from the chambers into the arteries
The doctor measured his systolic blood pressure.

disagreeable to taste, smell, or look at; morally objectionable
He was involved in some unsavory business dealings.

relating to or characterized by vibration
The machine produced a strong vibrational hum.

relating to the measurement of volume
The experiment required precise volumetric measurements.

Clear, logical, and convincing.
She presented a cogent argument that convinced everyone.

Relating to dissociation.
She was diagnosed with a dissociative disorder.

knowing everything
The narrator of the story seemed omniscient, knowing every character's thoughts.

of or resembling the earliest ages in the history of the world
The explorers discovered a primeval forest untouched by human activity.

relating to rabbis or rabbinism
He studied ancient rabbinic texts.

without any reduction in intensity or force
The storm continued unabated for hours.

not able to be enforced or imposed
The contract clause was deemed unenforceable by the court.

Not suitable for living in.
The planet was found to be uninhabitable due to extreme temperatures.

Not saturated; (chemistry) having double or triple bonds.
Unsaturated fats are generally considered healthier.

Better than all others; unrivaled.
Her skill in painting is unsurpassed.

Having or showing a feeling of vague or regretful longing.
She gave a wistful smile as she remembered her childhood.

having both male and female characteristics
The artist created an androgynous figure that challenged traditional gender norms.

Delicious; highly pleasing.
The dessert was absolutely delectable.

tending to exclude
The club was criticized for its exclusionary policies.

silly; senseless
He made an inane comment that left everyone confused.

between different agencies
They formed an interagency task force to address the issue.

very rapid; sudden and spectacular
Her rise to fame was meteoric.

too enthusiastic or eager
His overzealous attempts to help sometimes made things worse.

harmful to someone or something; detrimental
The judge ruled that the evidence was prejudicial and inadmissible.

relating to or characteristic of a ritual
The ancient tribe performed a series of ritualistic dances.

without special knowledge or experience
For the uninitiated, the rules of cricket can be quite confusing.

not restrained or restricted
The children's joy was unrestrained as they opened their presents.

unexpected and inappropriate or inconvenient
Nothing untoward happened during their trip.

green with vegetation
The valley was a verdant landscape after the spring rains.

deviating from the normal or proper course
His aberrant behavior caused concern among his colleagues.

relating to algae
The pond had a thick algal bloom on its surface.

belonging to a period other than that being portrayed
The presence of a smartphone in a historical drama would be anachronistic.

relating to anarchism
The group discussed anarcho-syndicalist theories.

relating to bibliography or the history of books
The researcher compiled a comprehensive bibliographic list for her thesis.

of or relating to the northern regions of the globe, especially the forest biome
The boreal forest is characterized by coniferous trees.

playing a part in bringing something about
His negligence was a contributory factor to the accident.

contrary to intuition or to common-sense expectation
The solution to the problem was counterintuitive, but it worked.

relating to the theories of Charles Darwin
The concept of natural selection is a core Darwinian principle.

showing fearlessness and determination
The dauntless explorer faced the challenges of the jungle without hesitation.

of or during the day; daily
Most birds are diurnal, meaning they are active during the day.

overbearing; bossy
His domineering attitude made it difficult to work with him.

spherical or globe-shaped
The telescope revealed a globular cluster of stars.

relating to the action of hot water in the earth's crust
Hydrothermal vents support unique ecosystems deep in the ocean.
